nodes.label: When Software Meets Hardware
nodes.summary: An IoT modernization account connects physical test environments, device simulation, observability, recovery and continuous learning. The team used LLMs to explore unfamiliar areas, prototype experiments and develop engineering tools, including dashboards and migration trackers. The proposed benefit is cheaper experimentation and a shorter learning loop.
nodes.limitation: The article describes one team's practices and perceived benefits. It does not isolate AI's contribution or quantify productivity improvements. Physical-world validation remains part of the reported engineering process.
